theorem locallyMinimizing_powerLogDensity_one_classical_equations
    {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ κ₀ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hne : ¬ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0) (K : ℝ) (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) θ ℓ) :
    ∃ lam μ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      ((K / κ₀) * deriv (deriv θ) s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) ∧
      ((K / κ₀) * (deriv θ s) ^ 2 / 2 -
        lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      ((K / κ₀) * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s +
        (K / κ₀) * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 - σ * deriv θ s = 0)

        lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) +
        μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0) :

      (fun s => θ s + t * η s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) ℓ))

theorems.name: smooth_angle_firstIntegral_and_curvature

theorems.name: quadratic_curvature_equation

theorem quadratic_curvature_equation
    {κ : ℝ → ℝ} {k σ s : ℝ} (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 κ)
    (h : deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (κ t))) s +
      κ s ^ 2 * deriv (fun q : ℝ => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (κ s) -

        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =

        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =

    {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ ↔
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ →
        ψ 0 = θ 0 → ψ ℓ = θ ℓ →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) →
        (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,

theorems.name: constrained_secondVariation_exponentialWeight_corrected

theorem constrained_secondVariation_exponentialWeight_corrected
    {ε θ a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ lam μ β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (η ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (ha1 : deriv a 0 = 0) (hb1 : deriv b 0 = 0)
    (hx : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      cos (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s))
    (hy : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      sin (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))
    (hstat : ∀ ζ : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv ζ.val s) +
        lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) +
        μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε
      (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) ℓ))
      (-β * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ *
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η.val s)^2 -
          (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η.val s)^2)) 0

      (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s)) →

theorems.name: energy_le_iff_powerLog_exponentialWeight_le
theorems.statement:
theorem energy_le_iff_powerLog_exponentialWeight_le (p : ℝ) {β : ℝ}
    (hβ : 0 < β) (ε θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ ≤ energy ε ψ ℓ ↔
      powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ) ≤
        powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ)

theorems.name: locallyMinimizing_iff_powerLog_weight_local_maximum
theorems.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_iff_powerLog_weight_local_maximum (p : ℝ) {β : ℝ}
    (hβ : 0 < β) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ ↔
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ →
        ψ 0 = θ 0 → ψ ℓ = θ ℓ →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) →
        (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
          |ψ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv ψ s - deriv θ s| < r) →
        powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ) ≤
          powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ)

theorems.name: hasDerivAt_powerLog_weight_variation
theorems.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_powerLog_weight_variation {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (p β : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => powerLog p
      (exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ))
      (-β * exp (-p * β * energy ε θ ℓ) *
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η s)) 0

theorems.name: powerLog_weight_variation_stationary_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem powerLog_weight_variation_stationary_iff {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ β : ℝ}
    (hβ : β ≠ 0) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (p : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => powerLog p
      (exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)) 0 = 0 ↔
      deriv (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ) 0 = 0

theorems.name: powerLog_exponentialWeight_split
theorems.statement:
theorem powerLog_exponentialWeight_split {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (p β a ℓ : ℝ) :
    powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ) =
      powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ a) +
      powerLog p (exp (-β * (∫ s in a..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s)))) +
      p * powerLog p (exponentialWeight β ε θ a) *
        powerLog p (exp (-β * (∫ s in a..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s))))

theorem fderiv_constraintParameters_zero {θ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}

    (hnonconst : ¬ ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s = K)
    (η : variationSpace ℓ)
    (hηx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hηy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hηa : (∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      (xCoord θ 0 s * cos (θ s) + yCoord θ 0 s * sin (θ s)) * η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : variationSpace ℓ, ∃ a b c : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ 2 c 0 ∧
      a 0 = 0 ∧ b 0 = 0 ∧ c 0 = 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt a 0 0 ∧ HasDerivAt b 0 0 ∧ HasDerivAt c 0 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0,
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos
          (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) ∧
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin
          (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s)) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) ∧
        LinearInputAreaVariation.area
          (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s + c t * ξ₃.val s) ℓ =
            LinearInputAreaVariation.area θ ℓ

theorem exists_global_convergent_solution {n : ℕ} {lam r u gamma target : ℝ}
    {b : State n → ℝ} {kappa rho : Fin n → ℝ} {Phi : ℝ × ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ 1 b) (hPhi : ContDiff ℝ 1 Phi)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hkappa : ∀ i, 0 < kappa i)
    (htarget : (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam) < target)
    (q₀ : State n) (hinit : target ≤ E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2) :
    ∃ M : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ M i) ∧ ∃ q : ℝ → State n, q 0 = q₀ ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        HasDerivAt q (vectorField lam r u gamma target b kappa rho Phi (q t)) t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ i, |(q t).2 i| ≤ M i) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        0 ≤ E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2 - target ∧
        E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2 - target ≤
          (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2 - target) * Real.exp
            (-(gamma * gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2)) * t)) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        Metric.infDist (q t).1 {p : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u p.1 p.2 = target} ≤
          bandRadius lam r u (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2) /
            (target - (max (-r) 0) ^ 2 / (12 * lam)) *
            (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2 - target) * Real.exp
              (-(gamma * gradientLowerBound lam r u target (E lam r u q₀.1.1 q₀.1.2)) * t)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => E lam r u (q t).1.1 (q t).1.2) atTop (𝓝 target) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => Metric.infDist (q t).1
        {p : ℝ × ℝ | E lam r u p.1 p.2 = target}) atTop (𝓝 0)

    px * (-gamma * gap * px - b * py) +

theorems.name: decomposition_of_rate

    (hpos : 0 < px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)

    vx = -gamma * gap * px -
        ((px * vy - py * vx) / (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)) * py ∧
      vy = -gamma * gap * py +
        ((px * vy - py * vx) / (px ^ 2 + py ^ 2)) * px

      -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gSq lam r u x y) ↔
      ∃! b : ℝ,
        vx = -gamma * (E lam r u x y - target) * gx lam r u x y - b * gy x y ∧

    HasDerivAt (fun s => E lam r u (x s) (y s))
      (-gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
        gSq lam r u (x t) (y t)) t ↔
      ∃! b : ℝ,
        vx = -gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
          gx lam r u (x t) (y t) - b * gy (x t) (y t) ∧
        vy = -gamma * (E lam r u (x t) (y t) - target) *
          gy (x t) (y t) + b * gx lam r u (x t) (y t)

    (hmin : LinearInputAreaMinimum.LocallyMinimizing k θ ℓ) :
    ∃ p σ c : ℝ,
      LinearInputPressureStationary.Stationary k p θ ℓ ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
        (k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
          σ * deriv θ s = p) ∧
        E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
        HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
          (gy (deriv θ s) (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
          (-gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
            (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
        (deriv (deriv θ) s) ^ 2 / 2 + (deriv θ s) ^ 4 / 8 -
          σ * (deriv θ s) ^ 2 / (2 * k) - (p / k) * deriv θ s = c

theorems.name: circle_pressure_firstIntegral

theorem circle_pressure_firstIntegral (p s : ℝ) :

      p * (xCoord (fun r => r) 0 s * cos s + yCoord (fun r => r) 0 s * sin s) -
        p * sin s ∧
    (deriv (fun r : ℝ => r) s) ^ 2 / 2 -
      (p - p * yCoord (fun r => r) 0 s) * cos s -
      p * xCoord (fun r => r) 0 s * sin s = 1 / 2 - p

        (-1 / 2) * deriv (fun t : ℝ => t) s = 1) ∧

    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hstat : Stationary (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ) :
    ∃ σ c : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      E (1 / 2) (-σ / k) 0 (deriv θ s)
        (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv θ)
        (gy (deriv θ s) (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun t => deriv (deriv θ) t + sqrt 2 * deriv θ t)
        (-gx (1 / 2) (-σ / k) 0 (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s)) s
